title: Trump urges Congress to pass tax incentives to restore Hollywood’s luster
description: The loss of film and TV production to other countries ‘is hurting California very badly,’ the president said.

title: Vance wades into caustic Michigan Senate race, calling candidate ‘evil’
description: The vice president called Democratic nominee Abdul El-Sayed “very, very evil” and told him to stop talking about Vance’s wife.

title: Postal Service plans may keep voters from getting ballots, whistleblower says
description: An anonymous federal official warns that a rushed USPS portal tied to Trump’s mail-voting order could reject large batches of ballots before the midterms.

title: Why a candidate leading in North Carolina is running like he is behind
description: Roy Cooper, a Democrat running for Senate who has won four statewide races in North Carolina over a nearly four-decade career, finds himself in an enviable position — at least on paper.

title: In the Trump-voting town of Ontario, lake’s new name splits Republicans
description: Trump's order to rename Lake Ontario to Lake America has sparked both pride and objections among residents of Upstate New York.

title: Whistleblower claims USPS plan for Trump's mail voting order could 'derail' midterms
description: A whistleblower says the U.S. Postal Service is rushing out an online system for President Trump's push to restrict mail voting that could "derail" the midterm election if courts allow it to proceed.

title: Judge to decide if Tyler Robinson will go to trial in Charlie Kirk murder case
description: Utah District Judge Tony Graf Jr. will hear arguments over evidence introduced in July, to decide if there's enough probable cause for a trial in the shooting of the conservative activist last year.

title: Affordability is the centerpiece of Democrats' message in Pennsylvania swing district
description: A rematch in a swing district Pennsylvania is showcasing how Republican messaging from 2024 is getting a replay, this time from Democratic candidates.

title: In Massachusetts, Sen. Ed Markey and Rep. Seth Moulton vie for Senate nomination
description: Sen. Ed Markey faces Congressman Seth Moulton in the Massachusetts Senate primary. Both candidates have similar progressive platforms.

title: Some Jewish Republicans bashed JD Vance. Then he got a standing ovation.
description: The vice president appeared at a Republican Jewish Coalition summit at a time when many prominent donors and activists oppose his potential presidential bid.

title: Army secretary submits resignation to Trump after repeated clashes with Hegseth
description: The departure of Dan Driscoll, who at one time was viewed as a potential replacement for the defense secretary, is the latest shake-up at the Pentagon amid the Iran war.

title: Supreme Court clears way for White House ballroom construction to continue
description: The decision hands President Donald Trump a political victory in his controversial bid to oversee the largest addition to the executive mansion in decades.

title: Trump says U.S. might ‘smack’ Iran but that fighting is likely to remain limited
description: The president downplays the possibility of escalating military action against Tehran, despite recent tit-for-tat attacks.

title: Trump’s attempts to crack down on speech and influence opinion
description: As the midterm elections near, the Trump administration is appearing to ramp up its efforts to intimidate journalists and influence public opinion.

title: Trump touts new drug-price deals, seeking a midterm edge
description: Nine more pharmaceutical companies said they would cut the prices on some drugs through Trump’s Most Favored Nation program.

title: Mike Johnson said he supports ‘great member’ Max Miller’s reelection bid
description: The House Ethics Committee announced earlier this month that it is investigating accusations that Miller physically abused his ex-wife and daughter. Miller denies the allegations.

title: Kalshi suspends GOP House candidate for betting on her own race
description: Laurie Buckhout of North Carolina said she “bet on myself. Literally.”

title: Alaska Democrats back independent Bill Hill in statewide House race
description: Hill, a fisherman, has the most realistic chance of unseating Rep. Nick Begich (R), the state Democratic Party chair said. A formal position has yet to be decided.

title: Trump officials cut political interference ban after unusual Census Bureau report
description: After the Census Bureau issued a report tied to a Trump-aligned think tank, the bureau's parent agency cut language banning political interference from its scientific integrity policy, NPR learned.

title: Trump says voters who oppose data centers will ‘kill the Golden Goose’
description: The president defends the server farms as polling shows sizable shares of Americans from both political parties are opposed to them.

title: Judge orders forced feeding of alleged National Guard shooter
description: Rahmanullah Lakanwal, who is accused of shooting two National Guard troops in D.C., one fatally, had been refusing food and water as he awaits trial.

title: Kalshi bans former congressman George Santos for life after State of the Union trades
description: Kalshi says Santos did not cooperate with its investigation into bets he placed on his own attendance at the State of the Union. The company also fined the disgraced congressman more than $71,000.

title: A U.S. strike on Iran breaks a month-long lull, and Iran fires back
description: The U.S. attack hit rocket launchers in the Strait of Hormuz. Iran fired back early Monday, marking the first known clash in weeks.

title: Google unveils ‘Lake America’ for U.S. users
description: People in Canada will continue to see Lake Ontario on the company's maps, Google said, while those outside of the two countries will see both names.

title: Secretive deals may cut billions from U.S. global health spending, analysis shows
description: The planned reductions — targeting programs that combat the spread of deadly diseases — coincide with an administration push to make developing nations spend more.

title: The politics of the company you keep
description: The Senate race in Michigan is critical to Democrats, but associations may matter.

title: Vulnerable Republicans are eyeing Trump’s war chest. He has other plans.
description: Vulnerable Republicans cannot afford to antagonize Trump because they need his help to turn out his base and tap into the $400 million war chest he controls.

title: Trump says U.S. struck deal to take control of 65 billion barrels Venezuelan oil
description: President Trump is touting a new deal for the U.S. to access Venezuelan oil fields. Trump says it's a major boon for the American people, but it's unclear when they'll see the benefits.

title: Scholar discusses Trump's claims of a new Venezuelan oil agreement
description: NPR's A Martínez speaks with Francisco Monaldi, director of the Latin America Energy Program at Rice University, about President Trump's claims of a Venezuelan oil agreement.

title: The U.S.-Venezuela oil deal won't lower your gas prices. Here's what you need to know
description: The Trump administration announced a deal Friday to develop a vast amount of Venezuela's oil reserves, with the U.S. taking a majority stake. Energy experts say there are many reasons to be skeptical.

title: Funding bill at the top of the agenda as House returns from recess
description: The House returns Monday for one week before heading back home. At the top of the agenda is a bill to extend government funding past the midterm elections.

title: Trump says he will report NBC host to FCC for ‘rebuke or punishment’
description: The president’s latest in a string of threats against broadcasters followed a comment by Kristen Welker about “some mixed results” from his midterm endorsements.

title: Military leaders warn Hegseth against extending Iran war operations
description: A recent classified assessment advised that prolonged large-scale operations in the Middle East risk weakening U.S. capabilities elsewhere.
